broadcast_pp_sampled_tokens: broadcast sampled token IDs and rejection counts from the last pipeline parallel rank to all other ranks
receive_pp_sampled_tokens: receive sampled token IDs and rejection counts from the last pipeline parallel rank on non-last ranks
run_pp_broadcast_receive: run pipeline parallel broadcast and receive to synchronize sampled tokens across ranks
test_pp_broadcast: test the pp_broadcast function for broadcasting int64 token tensors and combined counts across pipeline ranks
test_pp_receive: test the pp_receive function for receiving token tensors and count arrays from the last pipeline rank
